Company Leave Policy.

Full time employees receive 20 days of paid vacation leave per calendar year.
Unused vacation leave may roll over up to 5 days into the next year.

Sick leave is separate from vacation leave and provides 10 additional paid days per year.
Employees must notify their manager before 9am on any sick day.

Parental leave provides 16 weeks of paid leave for either parent following a birth or adoption.
